subject: Music Production
title: Jack Antonoff's Indie Pop Touch
description: A quick, practical guide to Jack Antonoff's Indie Pop Touch.

hook.text: Jack Antonoff was the guitarist in the band fun. before discovering his passion for production.

buildup.text: He built a home studio and started crafting retro-flavored pop with warm synths and big drums.

discovery.text: Taylor Swift hired Antonoff, and their collaboration produced multiple Grammy-winning albums.

twist.text: Despite working with pop megastars, Antonoff insisted on keeping a lo-fi indie spirit in mixes.

climax.text: He became the most in-demand pop producer of the 2020s, shaping the sound of a generation.

punchline.text: An indie guitarist became pop's favorite producer.

quiz.question: Which megastar collaborated with Jack Antonoff on Grammy-winning albums?
